The '''LCK 2023 Spring''' Split was the first split of the 2023 season of the [[League of Legends Champions Korea]], organized by Riot Games. The competition ran from January 18 to April 9, with the Group Stage held offline at LoL Park in Seoul and the Lower Bracket Final and Grand Final played at Jamsil Arena. Ten teams competed in a Double Round Robin Group Stage using best-of-three matches, with the top six advancing to a Double Elimination Playoffs played as best-of-five. The winner and runner-up qualified for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2023|Mid-Season Invitational]]. The split was played across patches 13.1 through 13.5, with [[Aurelion Sol]], [[Yuumi]], and [[Viego]] disabled at various points for competitive reasons.

==Format==
*'''Group Stage''' - ''January 18<sup>th</sup> - March 19<sup>th</sup>, 2023''
**Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd till 6th place''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 10th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
*'''Playoffs''' - ''March 22<sup>nd</sup> - April 9<sup>th</sup>, 2023''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Winner and the runner-up qualify for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2023|Mid-Season Invitational 2023]]
